title: Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf 8.75-Inch Solid Brass | Spanish Gold | Covered Wall Mount | Glass Shelves | Allied Brass
description:
Keep toilet tissue protected and everyday essentials within reach with a wall-mounted toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf above the roll in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Create a clean, finished look after installation with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Save space around the vanity or toilet with a wall-mount layout designed for efficient organization

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 8.75 x 4.6 x 6 inches
- Material: solid brass hardware with glass shelf
- Mounting: wall mounted; concealed screw mounting hardware
multiple designer finish options available (28 finishes)
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Box dimensions: 18 x 12 x 6 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
